mechanism: Estradiol may increase budesonide systemic exposure through CYP3A4 inhibition and potentially increase corticosteroid effects, while budesonide may increase estradiol metabolism leading to reduced contraceptive efficacy.
action: Monitor for enhanced corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression) and consider alternative contraception or increased hormone dose; counsel on potential reduced oral contraceptive reliability.
